description: Answer how much funding was raised, how many rounds closed, or how many companies were founded, for a country, sector, series, and year. This is the StartupHub /analysis chart as data. Use it for questions like 'how much funding did Canadian startups raise in 2026'. dataset=rounds (default) is announced round capital in that year. dataset=startups is companies founded that year, and the dollar total is what those companies have raised to date, not capital raised during the year. dataset=funds is fund closes. dataset=investors counts firms founded, with no dollar total. country is a full English name: Canada, United States, United Kingdom. group=sector or group=country returns a breakdown. Free, no API key. Returns the count, total USD, a chart URL, and the periods or categories behind the total.

bucket.description: Time bucket. A single year defaults to year. A range defaults to quarter.

country.description: Full English country name, or a common alias. Examples: Canada, United States, USA, United Kingdom, UK.

dataset.description: rounds = capital announced in the year (default). startups = companies founded that year. funds = funds closed. investors = firms founded.

from.description: First year, inclusive. Ignored when year is set.

group.description: How to break the total down. Default time, which is the single undivided total. group=sector counts a company in every sector it carries, so that total is higher.

sector.description: Sector name, for example Artificial Intelligence or Fintech. Comma-separated for more than one.

series.description: Round stage: Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A, Series B, Series C, Series D, Series E, Series F+, Growth, IPO, Debt, Grant, Strategic. Comma-separated for more than one.

split.description: Optional second breakdown. The total still excludes double-counting.

to.description: Last year, inclusive. Ignored when year is set.

year.description: Calendar year. Sets both from and to. Example: 2026.

name: query_funding
title: Query funding totals
